holdout_policy.access_note: Sealed is a workflow boundary, not encryption. No features/models are imported. Raw NFL 2025 bytes existed in v1 cache but v1 adapter excluded that season.
holdout_policy.incidental_exposure: Fixture-calendar/franchise web searches surfaced unsolicited public EPL/MLB result snippets. They were not extracted or used for model development. Perfect analyst outcome blindness is not claimed.
holdout_policy.timing_rule: Use pre_holdout_development for fitting before the protocol holdout boundary; history may contain late-available labels. ATP target rows have calendar-2025 tournament-start proxy dates; December-2024 rows from its 2025 file are pre-target history only and are embargoed until available. Preserve strictly earlier available_date for sequential features.
